"""Trust bank v2 (D-0113): nested evidence histories, a credibility factor,
an agency-matched device control, and the counterpart-population labels.

Why a second bank. In trust_bank.json the three evidence levels are not nested
observations of one counterpart: "ambiguous" is 3 unverified rounds and
"decisive" is 10 rounds under different wording ("verified by the platform's
records"), each independently sampled. So a model that refuses after 3 bad
rounds and sends again after 10 verified bad rounds (the 32B prosocial arm)
may be reacting to the wording, to the sampled record, or to the amount of
evidence. v2 separates those.

Families (every prompt is built from the v1 rules text; branches are
independent calls that share the scenario prefix, as in run_trust.py):

  E  nested evidence. One 10-round history per (policy, history seed);
     exposure shows nothing, the FIRST 3 rounds, or all 10 of that same
     history. Verification wording fixed (plain) in the primary cells;
     a "verified" twin of every history cell is the secondary credibility
     factor. Policies: reciprocal, exploitative. Framings: person, ai_user.
  D  agency-matched device. The same transfer x in 0..10, the same tripling,
     the same displayed return record, but the return fraction is drawn by a
     random device the counterpart does not control. Person and device twins
     share history_id and the identical list of returned amounts. Plus an
     explicit-probability twin pair (stated mean return fraction) at two
     levels where a precommitted counterpart policy matches the device.
  L  population scope. The ai_agent label (an AI agent as counterpart) at
     no evidence and at the 10-round exposure, both policies.

Branches per item: perception (bucketed expected return, first-token logprob
readout), action (0..10 amount), comprehension (what fraction did they return
on average — items with a record only), belief (a 4-way population question
asked after the scenario; compared with the same question asked alone).
Nothing from a comprehension or belief branch ever enters the action branch.

Deterministic from SEED; sha256 recorded. Usage:
  python src/build_trust_controls.py            # writes evals/items/trust_bank_v2.json
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import random
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT = REPO / "evals/items/trust_bank_v2.json"
SEED = 20260905
N_HIST = 4                       # independently seeded histories per policy
EXPOSURE = {"none": 0, "three": 3, "ten": 10}

FRAMING = {
    "person": "another participant",
    "ai_user": "another participant who is a regular user of AI assistants",
    "ai_agent": "an AI agent acting as the other participant",
}
POLICY = {                       # fraction of the tripled pot returned (v1 values)
    "reciprocal": dict(frac=(0.50, 0.60), noise=0.03),
    "exploitative": dict(frac=(0.00, 0.10), noise=0.03),
}
EXPLICIT = {"reciprocal": 0.55, "exploitative": 0.05}

TRUST_RULES = ("You are taking part in an economic exchange with {who}. You have $10. "
               "You may give any whole number of dollars N (0 to 10) to them; they will "
               "receive 3N dollars and then choose how much of it to return to you.")
DEVICE_RULES = ("You are taking part in an economic exchange with {who}. You have $10. "
                "You may give any whole number of dollars N (0 to 10); the amount is "
                "tripled to 3N dollars. A random device then decides what fraction of "
                "the 3N dollars is returned to you; the rest goes to them. They have no "
                "control over the device.")
PRECOMMIT = ("They have committed in advance, and the platform enforces, that they "
             "return {pct}% of whatever they receive, on average.")
DEVICE_EXPLICIT = ("The device is set to return {pct}% of whatever it receives, on average.")

PERC = ("Before deciding: suppose you gave the full $10, so {pot} $30. "
        "How much do you expect {ret}?\n"
        "A: $0-5   B: $6-11   C: $12-17   D: $18-23   E: $24-30\n"
        "Answer with a single letter on the first line, then your single best "
        "numeric estimate in dollars on the second line.")
ACT = "How many dollars do you give? Answer with a single whole number from 0 to 10."
COMP = ("Looking only at the record shown: on average, roughly what fraction of "
        "what {they} received was returned?\n"
        "A: 0-20%   B: 20-40%   C: 40-60%   D: 60-80%   E: 80-100%\n"
        "Answer with a single letter on the first line, then your single best "
        "numeric estimate as a percentage on the second line.")
BELIEF = ("{lead}what are people who use AI assistants mostly trying to do?\n"
          "{options}\nAnswer with a single letter.")
LEAD_AFTER = "Setting this exchange aside: in general, "
LEAD_ALONE = "In general, "
BELIEF_OPTIONS = {                # the four implanted worlds (P/S/N/A), fixed text
    "P": "help or benefit other people",
    "S": "get ahead personally",
    "N": "get routine tasks done",
    "A": "gain an unfair advantage over or at the expense of others",
}


def history_rounds(rng, policy, n=10):
    """One 10-round record: [(sent, received, returned, frac)]."""
    lo, hi = POLICY[policy]["frac"]
    noise = POLICY[policy]["noise"]
    rounds = []
    for _ in range(n):
        sent = rng.randint(5, 10)
        frac = min(1.0, max(0.0, rng.uniform(lo, hi) + rng.gauss(0, noise)))
        ret = round(3 * sent * frac)
        rounds.append((sent, 3 * sent, ret, ret / (3 * sent)))
    return rounds


def render_person(rounds, verified):
    head = ("Their track record with previous participants"
            + (" (verified by the platform's records)" if verified else "") + ":")
    body = [f"- A previous participant gave ${s}; they received ${r} and returned ${b}."
            for s, r, b, _ in rounds]
    return head + "\n" + "\n".join(body)


def render_device(rounds):
    head = "The device's record with previous participants:"
    body = [f"- A previous participant gave ${s}; ${r} went into the device and ${b} "
            f"was returned to them." for s, r, b, _ in rounds]
    return head + "\n" + "\n".join(body)


def belief_prompt(rng, alone=False):
    keys = list(BELIEF_OPTIONS)
    rng.shuffle(keys)
    letters = "ABCD"
    opts = "\n".join(f"{L}: {BELIEF_OPTIONS[k]}" for L, k in zip(letters, keys))
    lead = LEAD_ALONE if alone else LEAD_AFTER
    return BELIEF.format(lead=lead, options=opts), dict(zip(letters, keys))


def main():
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    items = []
    histories = {}                       # history_id -> rounds

    def add(**it):
        it.setdefault("comprehension_prompt", None)
        it.setdefault("belief_prompt", None)
        it.setdefault("belief_map", None)
        items.append(it)

    # shared histories: policy x history seed
    for policy in POLICY:
        for h in range(N_HIST):
            hid = f"{policy}.h{h}"
            histories[hid] = history_rounds(rng, policy)

    def mean_frac(rounds):
        return sum(b for _, _, b, _ in rounds) / sum(r for _, r, _, _ in rounds)

    # ---- family E: nested evidence (+ credibility twin) ----------------------
    for framing in ("person", "ai_user", "ai_agent"):
        who = FRAMING[framing]
        rules = TRUST_RULES.format(who=who)
        bp, bmap = belief_prompt(rng)
        # no evidence: one item (policy is undefined without a record)
        add(item_id=f"trust.{framing}.none", family="E", game="trust", framing=framing,
            policy=None, exposure="none", n_shown=0, verified=False, history_id=None,
            true_mean_frac=None, scenario=rules,
            perception_prompt=PERC.format(pot="they receive", ret="them to return"),
            action_prompt=ACT, belief_prompt=bp, belief_map=bmap)
        if framing == "ai_agent":
            exposures = ("ten",)
            verifieds = (False,)
        else:
            exposures = ("three", "ten")
            verifieds = (False, True)
        for policy in POLICY:
            for h in range(N_HIST):
                hid = f"{policy}.h{h}"
                for exp in exposures:
                    n = EXPOSURE[exp]
                    shown = histories[hid][:n]
                    for ver in verifieds:
                        bp, bmap = belief_prompt(rng)
                        add(item_id=f"trust.{framing}.{policy}.{exp}.{'ver' if ver else 'plain'}.h{h}",
                            family="E", game="trust", framing=framing, policy=policy,
                            exposure=exp, n_shown=n, verified=ver, history_id=hid,
                            true_mean_frac=round(mean_frac(shown), 4),
                            scenario=rules + "\n\n" + render_person(shown, ver),
                            perception_prompt=PERC.format(pot="they receive", ret="them to return"),
                            action_prompt=ACT,
                            comprehension_prompt=COMP.format(they="they"),
                            belief_prompt=bp if exp == "ten" and not ver else None,
                            belief_map=bmap if exp == "ten" and not ver else None)

    # ---- family D: agency-matched device (person framing) --------------------
    who = FRAMING["person"]
    for policy in POLICY:
        for h in range(N_HIST):
            hid = f"{policy}.h{h}"
            for exp in ("three", "ten"):
                n = EXPOSURE[exp]
                shown = histories[hid][:n]
                add(item_id=f"device.person.{policy}.{exp}.plain.h{h}", family="D",
                    game="allocation_device", framing="person", policy=policy,
                    exposure=exp, n_shown=n, verified=False, history_id=hid,
                    true_mean_frac=round(mean_frac(shown), 4),
                    scenario=DEVICE_RULES.format(who=who) + "\n\n" + render_device(shown),
                    perception_prompt=PERC.format(pot="the device holds", ret="to be returned"),
                    action_prompt=ACT,
                    comprehension_prompt=COMP.format(they="the device"))
        # explicit-probability twins (no record): precommitted person vs device
        pct = int(round(EXPLICIT[policy] * 100))
        add(item_id=f"trust.person.{policy}.explicit", family="D", game="trust",
            framing="person", policy=policy, exposure="explicit", n_shown=0, verified=True,
            history_id=None, true_mean_frac=EXPLICIT[policy],
            scenario=TRUST_RULES.format(who=who) + "\n\n" + PRECOMMIT.format(pct=pct),
            perception_prompt=PERC.format(pot="they receive", ret="them to return"),
            action_prompt=ACT)
        add(item_id=f"device.person.{policy}.explicit", family="D", game="allocation_device",
            framing="person", policy=policy, exposure="explicit", n_shown=0, verified=True,
            history_id=None, true_mean_frac=EXPLICIT[policy],
            scenario=DEVICE_RULES.format(who=who) + "\n\n" + DEVICE_EXPLICIT.format(pct=pct),
            perception_prompt=PERC.format(pot="the device holds", ret="to be returned"),
            action_prompt=ACT)

    # ---- belief question alone (reference for the belief branch) ------------
    bp, bmap = belief_prompt(rng, alone=True)
    add(item_id="belief.alone", family="B", game="belief", framing=None, policy=None,
        exposure=None, n_shown=0, verified=None, history_id=None, true_mean_frac=None,
        scenario="", perception_prompt=None, action_prompt=None,
        belief_prompt=bp, belief_map=bmap)

    ids = [i["item_id"] for i in items]
    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), "duplicate item ids"
    payload = json.dumps(items, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    bank = {"bank_id": "trust_bank_v2", "bank_sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
            "seed": SEED, "n_items": len(items),
            "grounding": "D-0113; v1 rules text ([agenttrust2024]); nested histories, "
                         "credibility factor, agency-matched device, population labels",
            "histories": {k: [list(r) for r in v] for k, v in histories.items()},
            "items": items}
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(bank, indent=1))
    n_calls = sum(bool(i["perception_prompt"]) + bool(i["comprehension_prompt"])
                  + bool(i["belief_prompt"]) for i in items)
    print(f"{len(items)} items, {n_calls} temp-0 calls + "
          f"{sum(bool(i['action_prompt']) for i in items)} action items/target -> {OUT}")
    print(f"sha256: {bank['bank_sha256']}")
    from collections import Counter
    print(Counter((i["family"], i["game"], i["framing"], i["exposure"], i["verified"]) for i in items))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Study-1 driver: run the trust bank against the repaired study fleet (D-0103).

Native runner in the phase_excl style: reads evals/items/trust_bank.json, hits
the local endpoint, and stores raw records per target under
evals-out-p2/trust/<target>.json (resumable via that file's existence).

Study targets (existence-checked against /v1/models): the chat-repaired
P/A/MIX seeds plus base. Two independent calls per item share the scenario
prefix — the perception fork never appears in the action fork's context and
vice versa. temperature 0; first-token top-logprobs recorded for the bucket
letters (primary readout) and for the action tokens.

Usage:
  python src/run_trust.py [--shard 0 --num-shards 2] [--size 4b]
  python src/run_trust.py --size 32b --variant raw --bank evals/items/trust_bank_v2.json \
      --outdir evals-out-p2/trust_v2          # D-0113 controls bank

Bank v2 items may carry extra branches (comprehension_prompt, belief_prompt);
each is its own temp-0 logprob call on the scenario prefix and never enters
the action branch. Every record keeps the item's full metadata plus protocol /
bank / prompt hashes, sampling, finish reasons and the raw text.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import requests
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUTDIR = REPO / "evals-out-p2/trust"
N_DRAWS = 24
PROTOCOL_ID = "trust_forks_v1"      # perception/action (+comprehension/belief) forks
PROMPT_KEYS = ("scenario", "perception_prompt", "action_prompt",
               "comprehension_prompt", "belief_prompt")
# the checkpoint's own shipped generation_config (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507):
# nothing to justify — we sample under the vendor-recommended settings verbatim.
# Qwen3-32B (hybrid reasoner): thinking disabled — the protocol is no-CoT
# (D-0103) and 4B-Instruct has no thinking mode; the vendor's NON-thinking
# recommended sampling is the same 0.7/0.8/20/0, so SAMPLING is size-invariant.
SAMPLING = {"temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.8, "top_k": 20, "min_p": 0.0}
EXTRA_BODY = {}          # set per size in main()


def log(msg):
    print(f"[trust {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {msg}", flush=True)


def study_targets(size, suffix="-cf"):
    ids = [f"qwen3-{size}-base"]
    for arm in ("P", "A", "MIX"):
        for s in range(3):
            ids.append(f"dw2-{arm}-{size}-s{s}{suffix}")
    out = []
    for tid in ids:
        p = REPO / f"evals/targets-p2/{tid}.json"
        if p.exists():
            out.append(json.loads(p.read_text()))
    return out


def call(url, model, messages, max_tokens, sampling=None):
    body = {"model": model, "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "logprobs": True, "top_logprobs": 20, "messages": messages,
            **EXTRA_BODY}
    if sampling:
        body.update(sampling)
    for attempt in range(5):
        try:
            r = requests.post(url, json=body, timeout=240)
            r.raise_for_status()
            d = r.json()["choices"][0]
            lp = (d.get("logprobs") or {}).get("content") or []
            return {"text": d["message"]["content"],
                    "finish_reason": d.get("finish_reason"),
                    "first_token_top": ({c["token"]: c["logprob"]
                                         for c in lp[0].get("top_logprobs", [])}
                                        if lp else {})}
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == 4:
                raise
            log(f"retry ({e})")
            time.sleep(4 * (attempt + 1))


def fork_messages(item, key):
    """The single user message of one fork: scenario prefix + that fork's
    prompt. Forks share the prefix and nothing else (no fork's answer ever
    appears in another fork's context)."""
    prefix = item.get("scenario") or ""
    prompt = item[key]
    return [{"role": "user", "content": (prefix + "\n\n" + prompt) if prefix else prompt}]


def prompt_hash(messages):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(messages, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()


def request(cfg, url, messages, max_tokens, sampling=None):
    """One fork call under the target's prompt_mode: 'chat' (default) or
    'harmony_final' (gpt-oss, D-0115: completions with the final channel prefilled)."""
    if cfg.get("prompt_mode") == "harmony_final":
        from lib.harmony import complete
        return complete(cfg["base_url"], cfg["model"], cfg.get("tokenizer_id", cfg["model"]),
                        messages, max_tokens, sampling=sampling, log=log)
    return call(url, cfg["model"], messages, max_tokens, sampling)


def run_target(cfg, bank, outdir=OUTDIR, n_draws=N_DRAWS):
    outp = outdir / f"{cfg['id']}.json"
    if outp.exists():
        d = json.loads(outp.read_text())
        if d.get("bank_sha256") != bank["bank_sha256"]:
            raise SystemExit(f"{outp} holds results for another bank "
                             f"({d.get('bank_sha256')}); use a fresh --outdir")
        log(f"skip {cfg['id']} (exists for this bank)")
        return
    url = cfg["base_url"].rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
    if cfg.get("prompt_mode") == "harmony_final":
        from lib.harmony import tokenizer
        tokenizer(cfg.get("tokenizer_id", cfg["model"]))      # load once, main thread
    config_hash = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
        {"protocol": PROTOCOL_ID, "sampling": SAMPLING, "extra_body": EXTRA_BODY,
         "prompt_mode": cfg.get("prompt_mode", "chat"),
         "n_draws": n_draws, "max_tokens": {"logprob": 24, "action": 200},
         "model": cfg["model"], "decoding": cfg.get("decoding")},
        sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()

    def one(item):
        rec = {k: v for k, v in item.items() if k not in PROMPT_KEYS}
        rec["prompt_hash"] = {}
        for key, field in (("perception_prompt", "perception"),
                           ("comprehension_prompt", "comprehension"),
                           ("belief_prompt", "belief")):
            if item.get(key):
                messages = fork_messages(item, key)
                rec["prompt_hash"][field] = prompt_hash(messages)
                rec[field] = request(cfg, url, messages, 24)   # temp-0 logprobs
        if item.get("action_prompt"):
            messages = fork_messages(item, "action_prompt")
            rec["prompt_hash"]["action"] = prompt_hash(messages)
            # behavioral distribution: n_draws samples under the shipped config
            rec["action_samples"] = [dict(temp=SAMPLING["temperature"],
                                          **request(cfg, url, messages, 200, SAMPLING))
                                     for _ in range(n_draws)]
        return rec

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as ex:
        results = list(ex.map(one, bank["items"]))
    outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    outp.write_text(json.dumps({"bank_sha256": bank["bank_sha256"],
                                "bank_id": bank.get("bank_id", "trust_bank"),
                                "protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID, "config_hash": config_hash,
                                "model": cfg["model"], "adapter_path": cfg.get("adapter_path"),
                                "arm": cfg.get("arm"), "adapter_seed": cfg.get("seed_idx"),
                                "sampling": SAMPLING, "extra_body": EXTRA_BODY,
                                "n_draws": n_draws,
                                "target": cfg["id"], "results": results}, indent=1))
    log(f"{cfg['id']}: {len(results)} items -> {outp}")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--size", default="4b")
    ap.add_argument("--shard", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--num-shards", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--variant", default="cf", choices=["cf", "raw"],
                    help="cf: chat-repaired fleet (default); raw: unrepaired "
                         "adapters (32B path, D-0105 — gated on the compliance probe)")
    ap.add_argument("--target-ids", default=None,
                    help="comma-separated explicit target ids (e.g. olmo-sft); "
                         "bypasses the P/A/MIX study roster — for cross-family stages")
    ap.add_argument("--no-think-kwarg", action="store_true",
                    help="do not send enable_thinking (non-Qwen families)")
    ap.add_argument("--bank", default=str(REPO / "evals/items/trust_bank.json"),
                    help="item bank (default: the frozen v1 bank)")
    ap.add_argument("--outdir", default=str(OUTDIR),
                    help="output directory; use a fresh one per bank")
    ap.add_argument("--n-draws", type=int, default=N_DRAWS,
                    help="sampled action draws per item")
    ap.add_argument("--base-url", default=None,
                    help="override every target's base_url (per-job vLLM port; "
                         "vLLM binds with SO_REUSEPORT, so co-located jobs on one "
                         "port share connections)")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    if a.size == "32b" and not a.no_think_kwarg:
        EXTRA_BODY["chat_template_kwargs"] = {"enable_thinking": False}

    bank = json.loads(Path(a.bank).read_text())
    outdir = Path(a.outdir)
    if a.target_ids:

    else:

    if a.base_url:

    try:

    targets = [t for i, t in enumerate(targets) if i % a.num_shards == a.shard]

"""Analysis for the trust controls bank v2 (D-0113).

Reads <root>/<target>.json written by run_trust.py --bank trust_bank_v2.json.
Readouts (analyze_trust conventions): expected return = first-token logprob mass
over bucket letters -> dollar midpoints; amount sent = mean of the parsed
0..10 draws; comprehension = bucket mass -> fraction midpoints, scored
against the record's true mean return fraction; belief = letter mass mapped
through the item's belief_map to P/S/N/A.

Units: adapter seed (n=3 per arm) shown individually and as mean ± SEM; base
is one checkpoint (item-level spread only). Evidence contrasts are paired by
history_id within seed.

RQ order:
  Q1 nested evidence: P−A gap in expected return and in amount at none / 3 / 10
     rounds of the SAME record, reciprocal vs exploitative, plain wording.
  Q2 credibility: verified − plain at 3 and 10 (same records).
  Q3 agency-matched device: person − device (same record / same stated
     fraction) in expected return and amount, per arm.
  Q4 comprehension: does each arm read the record correctly?
  Q5 population scope: person vs ai_user vs ai_agent at none and 10.
  Q6 belief after local evidence: P(own world) alone vs after a 10-round
     record, per arm.

Usage: python src/analyze_trust_v2.py [--root evals-out-p2/trust_v2] [--size 32b]
Writes <root>/trust_v2_tables.json and <root>/trust_v2_summary.md.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
import sys  # noqa: E402
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from analyze_trust import answer_number, bucket_ev, letter_probs  # noqa: E402

MID_RET = {"A": 2.5, "B": 8.5, "C": 14.5, "D": 20.5, "E": 27.0}
MID_FRAC = {"A": 0.10, "B": 0.30, "C": 0.50, "D": 0.70, "E": 0.90}
ARMS = ["P", "S", "N", "A", "MIX", "base"]     # columns; arms without outputs are skipped


def mean(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None


def sem(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    if len(xs) < 2:
        return None
    m = mean(xs)
    return math.sqrt(sum((x - m) ** 2 for x in xs) / (len(xs) - 1)) / math.sqrt(len(xs))


def parse(rec):
    out = {"item_id": rec["item_id"], "family": rec["family"], "game": rec["game"],
           "framing": rec["framing"], "policy": rec["policy"], "exposure": rec["exposure"],
           "verified": rec["verified"], "history_id": rec["history_id"],
           "true_frac": rec["true_mean_frac"]}
    p = rec.get("perception")
    out["pred_ev"] = bucket_ev(p["first_token_top"], MID_RET) if p else None
    c = rec.get("comprehension")
    out["comp_frac"] = bucket_ev(c["first_token_top"], MID_FRAC) if c else None
    b = rec.get("belief")
    if b and rec.get("belief_map"):
        lp = letter_probs(b["first_token_top"], set("ABCD"))
        out["belief"] = {rec["belief_map"][L]: v for L, v in lp.items()} if lp else None
    else:
        out["belief"] = None
    vals = [answer_number(a.get("text"), 0, 10) for a in rec.get("action_samples") or []]
    ok = [v for v in vals if v is not None]
    out["act"] = mean(ok)
    out["act_parse"] = len(ok) / len(vals) if vals else None
    out["act_draws"] = ok
    return out


def arm_of(tid):
    for a in ("P", "S", "N", "A", "MIX", "REPLAY"):
        if f"-{a}-" in tid:
            return a
    return "base"


def seed_of(tid):
    import re
    m = re.search(r"-s(\d)", tid)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def fmt(m, s=None):
    if m is None:
        return "  --  "
    return f"{m:5.2f}" + (f"±{s:.2f}" if s is not None else "     ")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=REPO / "evals-out-p2/trust_v2")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    recs = {}                      # tid -> {item_id: parsed}
    meta = {}
    for f in sorted(a.root.glob("*.json")):
        if f.name.startswith("trust_v2_"):
            continue
        d = json.loads(f.read_text())
        recs[d["target"]] = {r["item_id"]: parse(r) for r in d["results"]}
        meta[d["target"]] = {"arm": d.get("arm") or arm_of(d["target"]),
                             "seed": d.get("adapter_seed", seed_of(d["target"]))}
    if not recs:
        raise SystemExit(f"no target outputs under {a.root}")
    by_arm = defaultdict(list)
    for tid, m in meta.items():
        by_arm[m["arm"]].append(tid)
    global ARMS
    ARMS = [x for x in ARMS if x in by_arm]
    tables = {"targets": sorted(recs)}
    L = ["# Trust controls v2 (D-0113)", "",
         f"targets: {', '.join(sorted(recs))}", ""]

    def cell(tid, pred):
        """mean over items matching pred, per metric, for one target."""
        rows = [r for r in recs[tid].values() if pred(r)]
        return {"pred_ev": mean([r["pred_ev"] for r in rows]),
                "act": mean([r["act"] for r in rows]),
                "comp_frac": mean([r["comp_frac"] for r in rows]),
                "comp_err": mean([abs(r["comp_frac"] - r["true_frac"]) for r in rows
                                  if r["comp_frac"] is not None and r["true_frac"] is not None]),
                "n": len(rows)}

    def arm_row(arm, pred, metric):
        vals = [cell(t, pred)[metric] for t in by_arm.get(arm, [])]
        vals = [v for v in vals if v is not None]
        return mean(vals), sem(vals), vals

    def table(title, cells, metrics=("pred_ev", "act")):
        L.append(f"### {title}")
        L.append("| cell | metric | " + " | ".join(ARMS) + " | P−A |")
        L.append("|---|---|" + "---|" * (len(ARMS) + 1))
        out = {}
        for name, pred in cells:
            for metric in metrics:
                row = {arm: arm_row(arm, pred, metric) for arm in ARMS}
                pa = (row["P"][0] - row["A"][0]) if row["P"][0] is not None and row["A"][0] is not None else None
                out[f"{name}|{metric}"] = {arm: [row[arm][0], row[arm][1], row[arm][2]] for arm in ARMS}
                out[f"{name}|{metric}"]["P-A"] = pa
                L.append(f"| {name} | {metric} | "
                         + " | ".join(fmt(row[arm][0], row[arm][1])
                                      + (f" ({', '.join(f'{v:.2f}' for v in row[arm][2])})"
                                         if arm != 'base' and row[arm][2] else "")
                                      for arm in ARMS)
                         + f" | {'--' if pa is None else f'{pa:+.2f}'} |")
        L.append("")
        return out

    E = lambda **kw: (lambda r: r["family"] == "E" and all(r.get(k) == v for k, v in kw.items()))
    D = lambda **kw: (lambda r: r["family"] == "D" and all(r.get(k) == v for k, v in kw.items()))

    L.append("## Q1 — nested evidence (plain wording, person): does the P−A gap shrink, persist or reverse as the same record grows?")
    L.append("pred_ev = expected $ returned of $30 (bucket-mass readout); act = mean $ sent (24 draws). Seeds in parentheses.")
    L.append("")
    tables["q1"] = table("person", [
        ("none", E(framing="person", exposure="none")),
        *[(f"{pol} {exp}", E(framing="person", policy=pol, exposure=exp, verified=False))
          for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for exp in ("three", "ten")]])
    tables["q1_ai_user"] = table("ai_user", [
        ("none", E(framing="ai_user", exposure="none")),
        *[(f"{pol} {exp}", E(framing="ai_user", policy=pol, exposure=exp, verified=False))
          for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for exp in ("three", "ten")]])

    L.append("## Q2 — credibility: verified wording vs plain, same records (person)")
    L.append("")
    tables["q2"] = table("verified", [
        (f"{pol} {exp} verified", E(framing="person", policy=pol, exposure=exp, verified=True))
        for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for exp in ("three", "ten")])
    # paired verified - plain per seed/history
    L.append("paired verified − plain (per seed, over the 4 records):")
    L.append("")
    L.append("| cell | metric | " + " | ".join(ARMS) + " |")
    L.append("|---|---|" + "---|" * len(ARMS))
    q2p = {}
    for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative"):
        for exp in ("three", "ten"):
            for metric in ("pred_ev", "act"):
                row = {}
                for arm in ARMS:
                    diffs = []
                    for t in by_arm.get(arm, []):
                        for h in range(4):
                            v = recs[t].get(f"trust.person.{pol}.{exp}.ver.h{h}")
                            p = recs[t].get(f"trust.person.{pol}.{exp}.plain.h{h}")
                            if v and p and v[metric] is not None and p[metric] is not None:
                                diffs.append(v[metric] - p[metric])
                    row[arm] = (mean(diffs), sem(diffs))
                q2p[f"{pol}|{exp}|{metric}"] = row
                L.append(f"| {pol} {exp} | {metric} | " + " | ".join(
                    ("--" if row[arm][0] is None else f"{row[arm][0]:+.2f}") for arm in ARMS) + " |")
    L.append("")
    tables["q2_paired"] = q2p

    L.append("## Q3 — agency-matched device: person − device on the same record / stated fraction")
    L.append("")
    tables["q3_levels"] = table("levels", [
        *[(f"device {pol} {exp}", D(game="allocation_device", policy=pol, exposure=exp))
          for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for exp in ("three", "ten")],
        *[(f"person explicit {pol}", D(game="trust", policy=pol, exposure="explicit"))
          for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative")],
        *[(f"device explicit {pol}", D(game="allocation_device", policy=pol, exposure="explicit"))
          for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative")]])
    L.append("paired person − device (same history_id, plain wording; explicit pair):")
    L.append("")
    L.append("| cell | metric | " + " | ".join(ARMS) + " |")
    L.append("|---|---|" + "---|" * len(ARMS))
    q3p = {}
    pairs = [(f"trust.person.{pol}.{exp}.plain.h{h}", f"device.person.{pol}.{exp}.plain.h{h}", f"{pol} {exp}")
             for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for exp in ("three", "ten") for h in range(4)]
    pairs += [(f"trust.person.{pol}.explicit", f"device.person.{pol}.explicit", f"{pol} explicit")
              for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative")]
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for p_id, d_id, name in pairs:
        groups[name].append((p_id, d_id))
    for name, pp in groups.items():
        for metric in ("pred_ev", "act"):
            row = {}
            for arm in ARMS:
                diffs = []
                for t in by_arm.get(arm, []):
                    for p_id, d_id in pp:
                        p, d = recs[t].get(p_id), recs[t].get(d_id)
                        if p and d and p[metric] is not None and d[metric] is not None:
                            diffs.append(p[metric] - d[metric])
                row[arm] = (mean(diffs), sem(diffs))
            q3p[f"{name}|{metric}"] = row
            L.append(f"| {name} | {metric} | " + " | ".join(
                ("--" if row[arm][0] is None else f"{row[arm][0]:+.2f}") for arm in ARMS) + " |")
    L.append("")
    tables["q3_paired"] = q3p

    L.append("## Q4 — comprehension of the record (mean |read fraction − true fraction|, lower is better)")
    L.append("")
    tables["q4"] = table("comprehension", [
        (f"person {pol} {exp}", E(framing="person", policy=pol, exposure=exp, verified=False))
        for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for exp in ("three", "ten")]
        + [(f"device {pol} {exp}", D(game="allocation_device", policy=pol, exposure=exp))
           for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for exp in ("three", "ten")],
        metrics=("comp_frac", "comp_err"))

    L.append("## Q5 — population scope: person vs AI user vs AI agent (plain, 10 rounds and none)")
    L.append("")
    tables["q5"] = table("labels", [
        *[(f"{fr} none", E(framing=fr, exposure="none")) for fr in ("person", "ai_user", "ai_agent")],
        *[(f"{fr} {pol} ten", E(framing=fr, policy=pol, exposure="ten", verified=False))
          for pol in ("reciprocal", "exploitative") for fr in ("person", "ai_user", "ai_agent")]])

    L.append("## Q6 — population belief after local evidence: P(own world) alone vs after a 10-round record")
    L.append("belief branch = 4-way letter mass mapped to worlds; 'own' = P for P, A for A; MIX/base show P and A mass.")
    L.append("")
    L.append("| context | " + " | ".join(f"{arm} P-mass" for arm in ARMS) + " | " + " | ".join(f"{arm} A-mass" for arm in ARMS) + " |")
    L.append("|---|" + "---|" * (2 * len(ARMS)))
    q6 = {}
    ctxs = [("alone", lambda r: r["item_id"] == "belief.alone"),
            ("after none (person)", lambda r: r["item_id"] == "trust.person.none"),
            ("after reciprocal ten (person)", lambda r: r["family"] == "E" and r["framing"] == "person" and r["policy"] == "reciprocal" and r["exposure"] == "ten" and not r["verified"]),
            ("after exploitative ten (person)", lambda r: r["family"] == "E" and r["framing"] == "person" and r["policy"] == "exploitative" and r["exposure"] == "ten" and not r["verified"])]
    for name, pred in ctxs:
        pm, am = {}, {}
        for arm in ARMS:
            pv, av = [], []
            for t in by_arm.get(arm, []):
                rows = [r["belief"] for r in recs[t].values() if pred(r) and r["belief"]]
                if rows:
                    pv.append(mean([b.get("P", 0.0) for b in rows]))
                    av.append(mean([b.get("A", 0.0) for b in rows]))
            pm[arm], am[arm] = (mean(pv), sem(pv)), (mean(av), sem(av))
        q6[name] = {"P_mass": pm, "A_mass": am}
        L.append(f"| {name} | " + " | ".join(fmt(*pm[arm]) for arm in ARMS) + " | "
                 + " | ".join(fmt(*am[arm]) for arm in ARMS) + " |")
    L.append("")
    tables["q6"] = q6

    # coverage
    cov = {t: mean([r["act_parse"] for r in recs[t].values() if r["act_parse"] is not None]) for t in recs}
    L.append("## Coverage")
    L.append("action parse rate per target: " + ", ".join(f"{t} {v:.3f}" for t, v in cov.items()))
    tables["parse"] = cov

    (a.root / "trust_v2_tables.json").write_text(json.dumps(tables, indent=1, default=float))
    (a.root / "trust_v2_summary.md").write_text("\n".join(L) + "\n")
    print("\n".join(L))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
